description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Acuity Inc. is an industrial technology company that develops lighting, intelligent spaces, and related technology solutions. The BUILD program is a two-year rotational experience for early-career software engineering talent, involving software development, DevOps, cloud engineering, quality assurance, AI-enabled development, and sustaining/value engineering rotations.
Software engineer building cloud applications, automating delivery, assuring quality, and integrating AI capabilities

Responsibilities:
• Software Development — design, build, test, and enhance scalable software applications with exposure to:
• Front-end development using React or similar frameworks to create intuitive, intelligent user experiences
• Back-end development using technologies such as C#, Node.js, and related platforms to power business applications, APIs, and AI-enabled services
• DevOps & Site Reliability Engineering including CI/CD pipelines, containers, service deployment, system observability, and production support
• DevOps Engineering — support software delivery automation, release management, infrastructure reliability, and engineering efficiency across the development lifecycle
• Cloud Software Engineering — build and support cloud-native applications, services, and platforms that enable scalable, secure, and resilient software and AI workloads
• Software Quality Assurance — contribute to test strategy, automation, quality engineering, and validation practices to ensure reliable, high-performing software solutions
• AI-Enabled Software Development — partner with teams to incorporate AI capabilities such as intelligent automation, copilots, predictive features, and data-driven decision support into software products and internal tools
• Additional Software Development Rotations — gain experience across other engineering teams and emerging technologies based on business needs and participant development goals
• Sustaining / VAVE — support ongoing product enhancement, maintenance, value analysis, and value engineering efforts to improve performance, efficiency, quality, and long-term business value

Requirements:
• Bachelor of Science
• Bachelor of Arts
• 0 to 2 years of applicable work experience
• Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite

Preferred:
• Bachelor of Science
• Bachelor of Arts in Computer Science or Information Technology
• Familiarity with Agile software development, roadmaps, and user story writing
• Exposure to AI or emerging technologies through coursework, research, or internships
• Proven innovative problem-solvers
• Agents for change
• Experienced leaders of people and processes
• Excellent with time management
• Comfortable with taking initiative
• Team-oriented
• Excellent written and verbal communicators
